title: Dukkaraṃ
text: 3 Kiṃ nu kho āvuso Sāriputta imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dukkaranti || || Pabbajjā kho āvuso imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dukkaranti || || 4 Pabbajjitena panāvuso kiṃ dukkaranti || || Pabbajjitena kho āvuso abhirati dukkarāti || 5 Abhiratena panāvuso Sāriputta kiṃ dukkaranti || || Abhiratena kho āvuso dhammānudhammapaṭipatti dukkarāti || || 6 Kiṃ va ciram panāvuso dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhu arahaṃ assāti || || Na ciram āvusoti || || Jambukhādaka-saṃyuttaṃ || || Tassuddānaṃ5 Nibbānam Arahattañca6 || [page 261] XXXIX. 1. 4] SĀMAṆḌAKA-SAṂYUTTAM 261 Dhammavādī Kimatthiyam1 || Assāso Paramassāso || Vedanā Āsavāvijjā || Taṇhā Oghā Upādānam || Bhavo Dukkhañca Sakkāyo || Imasmiṃ dhammavinaye Dukkaranti || ||  BOOK V SĀMAṆḌAKA-SAṂYUTTAM
